Interface ClientToServerActions

All Known Implementing Classes:
Client, ClientRmi, ClientSocket
public interface ClientToServerActions
Defines the set of actions a client can send to the server.

Implemented by Client and its subclasses. Each method corresponds to a distinct game or session operation; transport details (RMI vs. socket) are handled by the concrete implementation.
